description: Implementation of QrCodeSettingService for managing QR code settings, including saving, retrieving, deleting, and constructing QR code configurations within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: QrCodeSettingServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing QR code settings management, including caching, validation, and construction of QR code configurations.

methods.name: saveQrCodeSettings
methods.description: Validates and saves QR code settings for a tenant, then evicts cache and constructs mobile app settings.

methods.name: findQrCodeSettings
methods.description: Retrieves QR code settings for a tenant, utilizing cache.

methods.name: findAppFromQrCodeSettings
methods.description: Finds the mobile app associated with QR code settings for a tenant and platform.

methods.name: deleteByTenantId
methods.description: Deletes QR code settings for a specified tenant.

methods.name: handleEvictEvent
methods.description: Handles cache eviction event for QR code settings.

methods.name: constructMobileAppSettings
methods.description: Constructs or updates QR code settings with default or existing app links and configurations.
